## How to Run

```bash
# one-time asset preparation
mlperf fetch --workload nano-rag-agent --profile max

# benchmark run (writes JSON/HTML/CSV reports + .provd provenance)
mlperf run --workload nano-rag-agent --profile max --open-report

# quick smoke pass
mlperf run --workload nano-rag-agent --profile min

# research envelope
mlperf run --workload nano-rag-agent --profile pro
```

See the [running guide](../../guide/running.qmd) for profile semantics, report handling, and power measurement flags.
